To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
an integrated modeling framework was developed for water quality management in the Houjing watershed.
the integrated watershed management model and QUAL2K were applied for the Houjing River in Taiwan.
an integrated modeling system can be applied to evaluate the watershed management strategies for a polluted river in Taiwan.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a comprehensive watershed management plan for the Houjing River in Taiwan.
the development and implementation of watershed management strategies to improve water quality in the river.
the identification of the major pollution sources, development of watershed management strategies, and the evaluation of the watershed carrying capacity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the implementation of these proposed watershed management strategies would be effective in improving the river water quality in the future.
the proposed watershed management strategies could effectively improve the water quality in the lower reaches of the Houjing river and meet the proposed water-quality standards.
a combination of the above-mentioned watershed management strategies could be an effective approach to improve the water quality of the Houjing river.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of the integrated watershed management model and QUAL2K model can provide an effective tool to identify the major pollution sources and to develop the watershed management strategies.
the application of the above strategies could effectively improve the water quality of the Houjing river.
the application of the above strategies can reduce the NH₃-N loading by 10,488 kg/day, which is equivalent to the reduction of the NH₃-N concentration in river water from 1.2 to 0.3 mg/l.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed integrated watershed management model can be used to identify the major sources of pollution in the river, and can provide a framework for the development of watershed management strategies.
the integrated watershed management approach is an effective tool for watershed management and water quality improvement.
the application of the integrated watershed management strategies for NPS pollution and point source pollution control will help to reduce the river pollution and improve the water quality.
